note: Both sets share significant errors: both hallucinate a 5/16" bolt for Module A (source shows 3/8" or 5/8") and both misattribute the L3X3X1/4 angle profile to Module A (labels are in Module B section). However, Set B correctly binds the L3X3X1/4 profile to Module B, which Set A only captures generically ('Angle | size'). Set B includes a malformed claim ('S-301') and a redundant bolt claim, increasing its wrong/trivial count, but its successful specific binding of the Module B profile is a critical engineering fact that Set A misses.
